# Medesk

> Medesk is a comprehensive cloud-based medical practice management software providing EHR, appointment scheduling, telemedicine, billing, and clinical workflow tools for diverse healthcare specialties.

Medesk serves medical practices across multiple specialties including general practice, pediatrics, ophthalmology, surgery, and allied health professions. The platform integrates patient records, scheduling, communication, inventory management, and financial reporting into a unified GDPR-compliant system.

## Key Topics

- Practice Management
- Electronic Health Records (EHR)
- Appointment Scheduling
- Telemedicine
- Medical CRM
- Patient Communication
- Medical Billing
- Online Booking
- Clinic Management
- Financial Reporting
- Medical Inventory
- GDPR Compliance
- Clinical Templates
- Payroll Management
- Task Management

## Core Platform & Features

- [Medesk — Medical Practice Management Software](https://www.medesk.net/en): Medesk cloud-based practice management software for medical practices
- [Best Medical CRM for your Clinic | Medesk](https://www.medesk.net/en/medical-crm): Medical CRM for clinic business processes and patient management
- [EHR Software for Private Practice Management | Medesk](https://www.medesk.net/en/electronic-health-records-software): EHR software for secure digital patient records and treatments
- [Consultation Form Templates - Medesk](https://www.medesk.net/en/consultation-form-templates): Customizable consultation form templates using SOAP and ICD-10

## Patient Management & Scheduling

- [Clinic Online Booking | Medesk](https://www.medesk.net/en/online-booking): 24/7 online appointment booking for clinics and practices
- [Schedule - Medesk](https://www.medesk.net/en/schedule): Appointment scheduling with calendar sync and no-show reduction
- [Patient Communication Software | Medesk](https://www.medesk.net/en/patient-communication-software): GDPR-compliant patient communication via SMS, email, and video
- [GDPR-Compliant Online Consultation Software | Medesk](https://www.medesk.net/en/telemedicine): GDPR-compliant telemedicine and video consultation software

## Operations & Administration

- [Medical Billing & Practice Management Software | Medesk](https://www.medesk.net/en/billing-and-financial-reporting): Integrated medical billing and financial reporting for practices
- [Payroll Calculations](https://www.medesk.net/en/payroll): Automated payroll with salary calculations and commission tracking
- [Individually configured reports - Medesk](https://www.medesk.net/en/management-reporting): Customizable analytics and performance reporting for practices
- [Medical Inventory Management Software for Clinics | Medesk](https://www.medesk.net/en/stock): Real-time medical inventory tracking tied to appointments
- [Task management - Medesk](https://www.medesk.net/en/tasks): Task management and team collaboration for clinic workflows
- [Laboratory - Medesk](https://www.medesk.net/en/laboratory): Laboratory integration with automatic test results to EHR

## Specialty-Specific Solutions

- [Practice Management Software for GP Practice](https://www.medesk.net/en/gp-practice-management-software): Medesk practice management software specialized for GP practices
- [Practice Management Software for Paediatricians](https://www.medesk.net/en/pediatric-practice-management-software): Medesk pediatric practice management software for paediatricians
- [Practice Management Software for Ophthalmologists](https://www.medesk.net/en/ophthalmology-practice-management-software): Medesk ophthalmology practice management for eyecare clinics
- [Therapist Software for Allied Healthcare Practice | Practitioners](https://www.medesk.net/en/allied-health-practice-management-software): Medesk therapist software for allied health practitioners
- [Medesk for independent surgeons](https://www.medesk.net/en/independent-surgeons-practice-management-software): Medesk practice management for independent surgeons and referrals
